- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥0.6) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast slightly to align with mean reversion.
- When sentiment is strongly negative (≤0.2), model underestimates; adjust upward, especially if recent price is falling sharply.
- Model often overshoots after sharp price spikes (e.g., +10%+ in 3-5 days); apply a 1-2 day lag correction to avoid overreaction.
- If 3+ consecutive forecast days show downward trend, model may be too pessimistic; check sentiment for reversal signals and adjust upward.
- For 30-day horizon, model frequently underestimates late-period price peaks (last 7-10 days); add 2-3% buffer for sentiment-driven momentum.
- If sentiment history shows alternating highs/lows (e.g., +0.8, -0.2, +0.6), model tends to misalign with sentiment cycles; use sentiment-weighted smoothing for next 3-5 days.
